description: This file defines a Java interface for a Spring Data JPA repository managing Payment entities, providing methods to query payments by reference, customer, and customer policy.

classes.name: PaymentRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing Payment entities with custom finder methods.

methods.name: findByReference
methods.description: Finds a Payment by its unique reference.

methods.name: findByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves all payments associated with a specific customer.

methods.name: findByCustomerPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves all payments associated with a specific customer policy.
